name: EntityRef
description: A renderer-neutral reference to any host-resolved entity.

id.description: Stable host entity reference. It identifies an entity but grants no access to it.

label.description: Optional authored fallback label. Hosts may replace it with an authorized resolved label.

validation: id must be resolved and authorized by the host before interactive rendering
RelayMark carries no entity fields, access claims, or authorization credentials
an unresolved or unsupported reference renders its authored label or stable inert fallback

projections.plain_text: authorized label or authored fallback label
